output.reason: [ev-ffd2c3200e89] lists wireguard.userspaceFallback under "Removed Options" and says it "has been removed" and that WireGuard users "are required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support". So a configured value stops being honoured and the userspace fallback is gone, which fits setting-ignored (action) rather than a changed default. The evidence doesn't say what severity this has, and it doesn't say what fails on kernels without WireGuard support, so "high" is a judgement call and workload-failure isn't claimed. Separately, the values validator found the key in neither chart's default values [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5], which casts doubt on the subject, hence low confidence.
